findings.description: List page enumerated fully: 21 entries (19 under 'Our Faculty', 2 under 'Emeritus Faculty'), matching all 21 brief.people by name with no omissions in either direction. No Joint, Courtesy, Affiliate, Adjunct or incoming heading or designation appears on the page. Result: 17 included regular, 2 excluded current (Bamogho, Fateh), 2 emeritus. No announced incoming appointment found on the list page or the five profiles fetched.

Five official profile pages (Bamogho, Fateh, Fang, Nasiri, Mirafzal) were fetched to resolve ranks absent from their card blurbs; all downloaded after brief.created_at. Ranks for the other 14 current faculty and both emeritus are taken from the list page card text. Profile pages cited by this audit are on sc.edu under faculty-staff/.

Rod Leonard (Instructor, classed Staff, tagged Electrical Engineering in the college-wide directory, per the reported directory listing) is not on the EE Our People page and is not in brief.people. Not an omission from this roster. If confirmed, he would be excluded as teaching (Instructor). The college-wide directory is not a brief source and was not downloaded or verified by this audit.

Excluded as non-professorial. 'Faculty Fellow' is the only official title; no professorial rank. Category research_staff is a judgment call (policy names fellows among research roles). Outcome would change only if an official EE/ECE professorial appointment (regular, courtesy, joint/secondary or affiliate with rank) were stated.

Excluded as research_only: official title 'Research Associate Professor' is a research professor title. Profile also says she teaches, but no teaching-track title is stated. Outcome would change only if an official regular, in-residence, courtesy, joint/secondary or affiliate EE/ECE professorial appointment were stated.

Included regular: 'Molinaroli College Distinguished Professor' is a named professorship with professorial rank in the Electrical Engineering department; Graduate Director is a role, not a rank. Would change to excluded only if the rank were shown to be non-professorial.

Included regular: 'Thomas L. Gregory Endowed Professor' is a named professorship with professorial rank (profile also refers to him as Prof.). Not a courtesy or joint designation; no outcome change expected.
Included regular: 'Carolina Distinguished Professor' is a named professorship with professorial rank, listed in the main Our Faculty section.
Excluded as emeritus (past). Emeritus status is taken from the 'Emeritus Faculty' heading and card text; no profile was fetched.
